title: Standalone auth deploy of RF-177/RF-178 (#703, #705)
acceptance: Before deploying, `git diff --name-only 67496ab <deploy SHA> -- apps packages` lists only auth files (on 67fa6ca: auth lib, auth middleware, auth routes, index.ts's sign-out wiring, types, OpenAPI and their tests); anything else is moved to a later deploy or the owner agrees to include it.

Deployed from the Air via deployment-runbook.md with the owner's explicit deploy permission; HISTORY records the deployed SHA, Worker version, rollback version and smoke results, and the Now block's main vs production line is refreshed.

Post-deploy native checks: POST /api/v1/auth/session with a valid cookie returns 200 with no Set-Cookie; a sign-out from the iOS app revokes the session (the old cookie then gets 401 from /api/v1/auth/session).

Post-deploy web checks: browser sign-in works; GET /api/auth/get-session still returns a session and refreshes the cookie when due; a signed-in web tab reopened or refocused after at least a day stays signed in, since ordinary /api/v1 routes no longer extend the session row after #705.
nextAction: Owner checks: (1) on iPhone with the RF-1012 build (iOS #78, 37c6c8d, or later), the app stays signed in across launches, and signing out then makes the old session fail (sign in again works). (2) On web: sign in (or confirm a signed-in tab), open https://ritmofit.studio/api/auth/get-session in that browser and note session.expiresAt; on or after 2026-11-03 (at least a day later), refocus the app tab, open the same URL again and confirm it still returns a session whose expiresAt has moved later. A tab merely still being signed in the next day proves nothing, because the default 7-day expiry covers it even if extension is broken. (3) Once RF-155 renews the QA token, an agent runs the signed-in POST /api/v1/auth/session check (200, no Set-Cookie). Then the owner closes RF-183 or files a bug.
blocker: Waiting on the owner's device checks (iPhone with the RF-1012 build, iOS #78 37c6c8d or later; web session expiry on or after 2026-11-03) and on RF-155 (renewed QA token) for the signed-in POST /api/v1/auth/session check, which no agent can run without it.

evidence.summary: #703 merged as 1897a6d (RF-177: native sign-out exception, refresh only on /auth/session); not deployed.
#705 merged as 14d0b32 (RF-178: /auth/session sets no cookie); not deployed.

Production last observed at the 2026-11-01 start-session: main 67496ab, Worker feac7dde-dc10-4462-bd2d-79075d289bda, SPA assets/index-ChxMwIpX.js. Not rechecked since. Superseded: production is af800c8 / Worker d05bb48f since the 2026-11-02 deploy (entry below).

Owner decision (Air session, 2026-11-02): "Yes, drop both gates from RF-183" after an adversarial check. Production 67496ab's auth middleware is identical to pre-RF-177 8f26519, which already extends the row server-side and sends native clients no cookie, so the deploy does not regress pre-RF-1012 iOS builds; holding it keeps AUD-009 (native sign-out does not revoke) live. RF-180 and the iOS build no longer gate it; iOS RF-1012 merged anyway (iOS #78, 37c6c8d).

On main 67fa6ca, the runtime files changed since 67496ab are all auth: lib/auth.ts, middleware/auth.ts, routes/auth.ts, index.ts (withNativeSignOutOrigin wiring), lib/types.ts (sessionResolved), OpenAPI and their tests.

HISTORY's 2026-11-02 deploy entry: deployed af800c8 from the Air with the owner's permission (#712 issuecomment-6594161676): Worker d05bb48f-5f85-49c9-b08e-f0f4448d29d6 at 100% (rollback feac7dde, 67496ab), no remote migrations, git diff 67496ab..af800c8 -- apps packages auth-only. Gates, propagation 3/3, status smoke and security headers passed. Unauthenticated: /auth/session 401 with no Set-Cookie; native-shaped sign-out 200 (was refused before); form-shaped sign-out 415. 5-minute tail: 3 events, 0 exceptions, 0 5xx. Not run: signed-in /auth/session and iOS sign-out revoke (no QA token on the Air), next-day web check.

#713 (deploy record, merged 0092bf1) final review: next-day web check too weak against the 7-day default expiry, signed-in acceptance items unassigned without the QA token, status should be Blocked, stale production entry, deploy evidence ref held no output, Now block lost the RF-1012 pointer. Addressed in this record; the SPA hash was confirmed from the deploy log (assets/index-ChxMwIpX.js served after the deploy).
